cookie.description: LinkedIn session cookie for Voyager API search. Accepts: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools, or (2) full cookies JSON array from an extension like EditThisCookie. Required for keyword search; optional for direct event URL scraping.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

datePosted.description: Filter events by when they were posted.
datePosted.title: Date Posted

dateRange.description: Filter by event timing relative to today.
dateRange.title: Date Range

eventUrls.description: Direct LinkedIn Event page URLs to scrape. Accepts formats: https://www.linkedin.com/events/6234567890123456789/ or https://www.linkedin.com/events/ai-summit-2025-123456789/
eventUrls.title: Event URLs

maxEvents.description: Maximum number of events to scrape. Default: 50, Max: 500.
maxEvents.title: Max Events

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results with LinkedIn.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for LinkedIn Events (e.g., 'AI conference 2025', 'marketing summit'). Required unless eventUrls is provided.
searchQuery.title: Search Query
